nodes.label: SoybeanAdmin project (concept)
nodes.rationale: Provides a one-stop, ready-to-use, fresh and elegant admin template based on cutting-edge tech (Vue3, Vite7, TypeScript, Pinia, UnoCSS); also serves as a best practice for learning frontier front-end technology.

nodes.label: TypeScript
nodes.rationale: Strict typing improves maintainability; SoybeanAdmin enforces 100% type coverage as best practice for picking up TS.

nodes.label: UnoCSS atomic CSS
nodes.rationale: Pairs well with built-in theme configuration.

nodes.label: pnpm monorepo architecture
nodes.rationale: Adopted for clean and elegant project architecture; npm/yarn must not be used.

nodes.label: Elegant Router (file routing system)
nodes.rationale: Automated route imports, declarations, and types; eliminates manual wiring of routes.

nodes.label: SoybeanJS code specification
nodes.rationale: Combined with eslint, prettier, and simple-git-hooks to enforce code regularity.

nodes.label: ApiFox online Mock
nodes.rationale: Cloud-based mock so developers don't need to run a local mock server.

nodes.label: Permission routing (static + dynamic)
nodes.rationale: Supports both front-end static routes (src/router/routes.ts) and back-end dynamic routes for flexible permission models.

nodes.label: Directory structure reference
nodes.rationale: Documents canonical layout: build/, packages/{axios,hooks,scripts,utils,...}, src/{components,hooks,layouts,locales,plugins,router,service,store,styles,theme,typings,utils,views}.

nodes.label: Code sync workflow (cherry-pick)
nodes.rationale: Recommends `git remote add otherOrigin` + `git fetch` + `git cherry-pick` to selectively pull upstream commits, keeping forks current without merging.

nodes.label: sa cleanup command
nodes.rationale: Removes node_modules, dist, etc. for fresh installs.

nodes.label: sa git-commit command
nodes.rationale: Generates Conventional-Commits-compliant messages.

nodes.label: sa gen-route command
nodes.rationale: Generates route imports, declarations, and types via elegant-router plugin.

nodes.label: simple-git-hooks pre-commit
nodes.rationale: Pre-commit type checking improves code quality and reduces maintenance cost. Can be bypassed with --no-verify or removed for those uncomfortable with TypeScript.

nodes.label: useTable hook
nodes.rationale: UI-agnostic; manages request, data transformation, column configuration, and column visibility, decoupled from any specific table component or UI library.

nodes.label: useNaiveTable hook
nodes.rationale: Wraps useTable for Naive UI; provides scrollX and auto-refreshes columns on i18n change so $t() titles update immediately.

nodes.label: useNaivePaginatedTable hook
nodes.rationale: Adds pagination, mobilePagination, and getDataByPage on top of useNaiveTable for Naive UI DataTable.

nodes.label: useTableOperate hook
nodes.rationale: Encapsulates UI state and callbacks for add/edit/batch delete/single delete in tables, typically used with drawers/dialogs.

nodes.label: defaultTransform helper
nodes.rationale: Converts the unified backend pagination structure (FlatResponseData with records/current/size/total) into PaginationData<T>.

nodes.label: System icon rendering principle
nodes.rationale: Iconify svg JSON converted to Vue components via unplugin-icons; local svg via vite-plugin-svg-icons. Restart needed when svg files are modified because icons become baked-in components.

nodes.label: useSvgIconRender hook
nodes.rationale: Render-function adapter for NaiveUI icon rendering; returns SvgIconVNode usable for both iconify and local svg icons.

nodes.label: SvgIcon global component
nodes.rationale: Globally registered; accepts `icon` (iconify name) or `local-icon` (local svg filename) for dynamic rendering.

nodes.label: App.Service.Response type
nodes.rationale: Default response shape `{ code: string; msg: string; data: T }`; modify to match your backend. Success comparison driven by VITE_SERVICE_SUCCESS_CODE in .env (string-typed).

nodes.label: Cache (localStorage/sessionStorage) FAQ
nodes.rationale: Cache APIs are set/get/remove/clear; storage data types must be predefined in src/typings/storage.d.ts.

nodes.label: 404 after refresh (history mode)
nodes.rationale: history mode requires server fallback to index.html (e.g., nginx try_files); alternative is switching VITE_ROUTER_HISTORY_MODE=hash.

nodes.label: Naming conventions
nodes.rationale: Files: kebab-case lowercase; Vue components: PascalCase; iconify components: kebab-case (so iconify plugin renders directly); types/classes: PascalCase; vars/funcs: camelCase; constants: UPPER_SNAKE_CASE; styles: kebab-case.

nodes.label: Why Dayjs
nodes.rationale: ~2KB minimalist library; immutable sandbox API returning new instances prevents mutation bugs; opt-in i18n keeps bundles small.

nodes.label: Cross-domain (CORS) handling
nodes.rationale: Local: Vite forward proxy auto-configured. Production: nginx reverse proxy or backend CORS allow.

nodes.description: Use different backend addresses for dev/test/preprod/prod via env files

nodes.label: Alova Logo
nodes.description: Brand mark for Alova - a lightweight request strategy library. The icon consists of two mirror-symmetric chevron/arrow shapes pointing inward toward each other, rendered with gradient fills transitioning between cyan, blue, and purple tones. The composition resembles two stylized 'A' or arrow forms forming an abstract symbol that suggests bidirectional data flow or request/response exchange.

nodes.label: Alova (Request Strategy Library)
nodes.description: Alova is a JavaScript/TypeScript request strategy library used as an alternative to axios. The presence of this SVG icon in the base-web assets indicates the project either uses or references Alova as an HTTP client option for the Vue frontend.

nodes.label: VisActor Logo
nodes.description: Brand mark for VisActor visualization library — a circular emblem (200x200 viewBox) composed of a single fill-rule:evenodd path. The outer ring forms a near-complete circle with a stylized inner cut-out resembling an italic/slanted letter 'V' or actor figure (referencing the 'V' in VisActor). Uses currentColor for theming. Confidence: EXTRACTED (1.0) for the SVG geometry; INFERRED (0.95) for brand identification based on filename 'visactor.svg' which matches the VisActor.io open-source visualization toolkit by ByteDance.
